jobs.title: IT System Engineer (m/w/x)
jobs.description: Tiermedizin neu gedacht - mit dir! Rex hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Tierhalter:innen dabei zu helfen, sich optimal um ihre besten Freunde kümmern zu können. Um dies zu erreichen, wollen wir die tierärztliche Versorgung von Grund auf neu gestalten, wobei wir uns zum einen auf die Zufriedenheit und die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden im Team und zum anderen auf ein verbessertes Kundenerlebnis konzentrieren. Bei uns wird Deine Stimme nicht nur gehört, sondern wir brauchen Deine Erfahrung und Deine Perspektive, um Rex noch schneller weiter wachsen zu lassen. Warum bei Rex? Ganz einfach: Wir stellen uns der komplexen Herausforderung, die Veterinärmedizin digital zu transformieren. Dafür entwickeln und betreiben wir eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare Plattform, die sowohl eine herausragende Customer Experience als auch effiziente, datengestützte Praxisabläufe ermöglicht. Da wir kontinuierlich neue Praxen eröffnen und unsere Präsenz in Deutschland ausbauen, suchen wir jemanden, der sicherstellt, dass jeder neue Standort ab Tag 1 technisch startklar ist – und dass die Infrastruktur hinter unserer Plattform mit unserem Wachstum sicher und stabil bleibt. Baue und betreue die Systeme, die unsere Expansion erst möglich machen! Spannende Aufgaben warten auf Dich: Als unser IT System Engineer sorgst Du für verlässliche Systeme und treibst exzellente Prozesse in folgenden Bereichen voran: Praxis-Infrastruktur & Setups: Du planst und setzt das komplette IT-Setup bei Neueröffnungen um – von der IT-Beschaffung, dem Netzwerkdesign und der VPN-Anbindung an zentrale Systeme über die Bereitstellung von Workstations, POS-Kassen, Druckern und Peripherie bis hin zur Einrichtung und Fehlersuche bei medizinischen Geräten. Vor dem Go-Live validierst Du, dass alles reibungslos funktioniert. L aufender Praxis-Support: Du leistest Troubleshooting und Hardware-Support für unser wachsendes Praxisnetzwerk und entwickelst standardisierte, wiederholbare Setup-Prozesse, die mit jeder Eröffnung schneller und zuverlässiger werden. Cloud-Infrastruktur & Security: Du verwaltest und entwickelst unsere Cloud-Umgebung weiter und verantwortest das Sicherheits- und Zugriffsmanagement (IAM-Richtlinien, Credential Hygiene, Least-Privilege-Prinzip). Im Zuge unserer Skalierung hilfst Du uns, die nächste Stufe der Infrastruktur-Reife einzuführen (z. B. Load Balancing und automatisiertes Infrastruktur-Management). Compliance & Datenschutz: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Infrastruktur und Praxis-Setups allen Datenschutzanforderungen (inkl. DSGVO/GDPR) beim Umgang mit Kunden- und Patientendaten entsprechen – von Zugriffskontrollen vor Ort bis hin zu Speicherung, Absicherung und Auditierung in der Cloud. Monitoring & Reliability: Du überwachst die Verfügbarkeit und Performance unserer Systeme, nimmst an Rotationen teil und erkennst Infrastrukturrisiken, bevor sie zu Ausfällen werden. Engineering-Partnerschaft: Du arbeitest bei Deployments und Infrastruktur-Anforderungen eng mit unserem Software-Engineering-Team zusammen und bringst ein operatives Mindset in die Entwicklung und den Release-Prozess ein. Du verfügst über folgende Qualifikationen: Wir suchen IT Sytem Engineers, die sich sowohl im praktischen Hardware-Handling als auch im Cloud-Betrieb zu Hause fühlen – pragmatische Problemlöser statt Theoretiker, die nur an einer Ebene des Stacks arbeiten wollen. Standort & Sprache: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Ein aktueller Wohnsitz in Deutschland sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis sind zwingende Voraussetzung für diese Rolle. Reisebereitschaft: Bereitschaft (20%) zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen zu unseren Praxisstandorten. Erfahrung & Ownership: Mindestens 4 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der IT-Systemadministration, im Infrastructure Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren hybriden Rolle. Nachweisbare Fähigkeit, Infrastrukturprojekte eigenverantwortlich von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis zum Support zu steuern. Erforde

jobs.title: Laborleitung Galvanik, Hanau
jobs.description: Seit über 150 Jahren steht der Name unseres Klienten für Kompetenz in der Oberflächenveredelung von Metallen. Als einer der leistungsfähigsten Innovationsträger der Branche bieten wir der Industrie und dem Handwerk schnelle, kostengünstige und umweltbewusste Lösungen mit einem Höchstmaß an Professionalität und Individualität. Dabei gehen die Kompetenzen des privat geführten Unternehmens weit über die Gal­va­nik hinaus. Denn es betreut seine Auftraggeber bereits in der Projektierungsphase neuer Bauteile oder Systemlösungen und entwickeln im Bedarfsfalle Funktionsschichten. Aufgaben Fachliche und organisatorische Leitung des Labors mit Verantwortung für einen reibungslosen Tagesbetrieb. Planung, Priorisierung und Koordination von Laboraufgaben, einschließlich Ressourcen- und Kapazitätssteuerung. Sicherstellung der Qualität und Nachverfolgbarkeit von Mess- und Prüfergebnissen nach geltenden Standards und Vorgaben. Überwachung und Optimierung von Laborprozessen, Methoden und Arbeitsanweisungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung. Durchführung und Auswertung von Laborprüfungen sowie Übernahme der fachlichen Bewertung im Ergebnisprozess. Koordination von Instandhaltung, Kalibrierung und Wartung relevanter Geräte in Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stellen. Fachliche Führung, Unterweisung und Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeitenden im Laborbereich. Mitwirkung bei Audits, Abweichungsmanagement, CAPA-Themen sowie Dokumentations- und Schulungsprozessen. Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Laborumfeld. Umfassende Erfahrung in der Labororganisation sowie in der Durchführung und Bewertung von Laboranalysen und Prüfverfahren. Nachweisliche Kenntnisse in qualitätssichernden Prozessen und dokumentationsbasiertem Arbeiten (z. B. gemäß QM-/Standardanforderungen). Souveränes Arbeiten mit Laborgeräten, Messsystemen und datenbasierter Auswertung, inklusive Verstehen der technischen Zusammenhänge. Fundierte Kompetenz in der Planung und Steuerung von Arbeitsabläufen, Prioritäten und Ressourcen. Teamorientierte Führungs- und Kommunikationsstärke, verbunden mit klarer, strukturierter Entscheidungsfähigkeit. Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit Schnittstellen (z. B. Produktion, Qualitätssicherung, Einkauf, externe Dienstleister). Eigenständige, sorgfältige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Benefits Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen und möchten Ihr Fachwissen sowie Ihre Führungsstärke in ein Labor einbringen, das Qualität und Fortschritt konsequent verbindet? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit Ihren vollständigen Unterlagen. Zeigen Sie uns, dass Sie die richtige Laborleitung für unser Team sind. Mein Unternehmen vermittelt seit 25 Jahren Fach- und Führungskräfte speziell aus dem Bereich der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanik, Lack-, Pulver-, KTL Beschichtungen, Feuerverzinkung). Wir sind im D-A-CH Gebiet tätig. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Technical Lead Autonomy Hardware (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Team Lead Autonomy Hardware, you will own the hardware backbone of our ground autonomy stack: the compute platform, the full sensorset (camera, radar, lidar, IMU, connectivity), and its integration into a wide range of vehicles, from partner truck OEMs and UGV manufacturers to our own Mandrill UGV. This is a player-coach role: you will build and lead a high-performing, flexible, and experienced team while staying hands-on in design, verification, and integration. You will work at the intersection of autonomy software, vehicle manufacturers, our air and sea domains, and central supply chain, making sure our hardware is robust, reusable, and scalable. What is your Day to Day Mission: Team Leadership  Build, lead, and enable a high-performing, flexible, and experienced Autonomy Hardware team. Set priorities, ensure delivery quality, and establish best practices for design, documentation, and review. Stay hands-on: you challenge the design, review prototypes, and test alongside your team. Autonomy Hardware Ownership (Compute & Sensorset) Ensure that you and your team: Own the autonomy compute platform and sensorset architecture: camera, radar, lidar, IMU, and connectivity. Define and evolve the network topology of the autonomy kit. Benchmark compute platforms and sensors and drive make/buy and vendor decisions. Integrate the autonomy hardware kit into various vehicle types: trucks from OEM partners, UGVs from external partners, and our own Mandrill UGV. Own mechanical, electrical, and electronic integration: mounting concepts, power, schematics,  harness design, and interfaces. Design for robustness and demanding environmental conditions (vibration, temperature, EMC). Drive the full design process from concept to industrialisation: schematics, harness design, CAD, and simulation. Build and run VnV setups from breadboards and yellow boards to vehicle-level testing. Ensure designs are manufacturable and scalable: robust design principles, composition, and industrialisation. Cross-Functional & Cross-Domain Collaboration Work hand-in-hand with our Software and Prototyping teams to align hardware with the autonomy stack. Collaborate closely with vehicle manufacturers (truck OEMs and UGV partners) as external and internal stakeholders. Align with our Air and Sea domains to reuse hardware and leverage economies of scale across Quantum-Systems. Partner with central Supply Chain Management across the full lifecycle: early vendor engagement, sourcing, service agreements, and delivery schedules. What you bring to the team: Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a comparable field. 10+ years of hands-on hardware development experience; 2+ years in a leadership or team lead role. Background in automotive, defense, or robotics, ideally with experience integrating hardware into vehicles and working with OEMs. Strong expertise in sensor technologies (camera, radar, lidar, IMU) and embedded/edge compute platforms. Proven VnV experience: breadboards, yellow boards, benchmarking, and network topology design. Command of the full hardware design process: robust design for harsh environmental conditions, schematics, harness design, CAD, simulation, and industrialisation. Experience working with supply chain teams, from early vendor engagement to service agreements and delivery schedules. Strong communication and project management skills across engineering, partners, and suppliers; comfortable representing hardware topics towards OEMs and internal leadership. Fluent in German and English. Player-coach mindset: high ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment.   Your Benefits:  Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.  Culture & Environ

jobs.title: Head of Product (all genders)
jobs.description: Kertos Intro Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe. With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane , leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time. The market is growing by 20% every year , fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act . We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion. There has never been a better moment to join our team. Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us. Your purpose at Kertos As Head of Product, you own Kertos's product vision and roadmap, and you're joining at a genuinely pivotal moment. The category is being redrawn: compliance is shifting from software as a service to service as software, where AI and automation do the work wherever they can and our compliance experts focus on the judgment calls that still need a human. Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will. That means the roadmap in front of you is wide open. There are more good directions to take the product than we can pursue at once, across the segments we serve today and the ones we're growing into, and a real part of the job is choosing where to place the bets. You'll work closely with our compliance experts to understand exactly what clients need, and decide with your team and engineering where the line between automation and human judgment sits today, with the mandate to push it forward quarter after quarter as AI takes on more of the work. This role sits at the center of the product organization and value creation. You set the roadmap across squads, and you lead and grow the product team, partnering closely with our compliance experts and building around their knowledge, their needs, and their day-to-day work. You're accountable for the roadmap, for how the product team operates, and for outcomes clients can feel directly: time saved, risk reduced, audits passed. Your responsibilities Set the product vision, defining where Kertos product goes next, the shift from compliance software clients operate themselves to a service that delivers compliance outcomes for them, and turn that vision into a roadmap built around client value, not just feature velocity. Partner closely with our compliance experts to learn what actually creates value for them and our customers, and work with our Development Team to turn that expertise into a product that makes their work faster and clients' outcomes better. Continue to develop and mentor four product managers and two designers as the team scales, set the standards for how they run discovery and shipping, and make sure they grow into stronger PMs under you. Optimize the discovery process and work closely with compliance experts, design and engineering to understand problems deeply, validate ideas with real clients before building, and ship improvements that move a client's compliance outcome. Understand needs of customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing so product bets translate into revenue, retention, and measurable value for clients, especially as features move from "helps you do compliance" to "does the compliance work for you." Own the roadmap, setting priorities independently, and aligning them with technical leads, our customer advisory board, key clients, and the leadership team. Use data to define what success looks like for each initiative in terms clients would recognize, such as “time saved”, “risk mitigated”, “time to audit readiness”, and work with Marketing and Customer Success to turn usage data into the next round of decisions. jobs.title: Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d)
jobs.description: The role We’re looking for a Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d) to join our team and play a key role in developing software that connects and translates lab equipment hardware interfaces, automates machines, and powers our next-generation automation platform. As a core team member, you will be working on cutting-edge technology, building software that bridges the gap between software and hardware, enabling seamless integration across various vendors. Connectors are how we do it. Every instrument we bring online gets one, and every connector is built on our shared Python libraries: Bus, our Connector Development Kit, and the stack underneath them. Our mission is to empower researchers and engineers by bridging the gap between lab equipment and cloud-based automation. Our customers are solving critical challenges like curing diseases, developing sustainable materials, and addressing global food security. We provide them with the tools to connect their devices, automate workflows, and unlock new possibilities in R&D. Your mandate has two halves. Own the libraries as a product with real users, our own engineers today and external contributors later. And stay close enough to customer connector work that what you build is grounded in problems that actually exist. Why you'll love this role Your users are engineers. Your success lets other people ship connectors faster. That's a different craft from shipping features, and it's the one we're hiring for. Real hardware, real failure modes. Instruments time out, return garbage, and arrive with documentation that's wrong. You'll debug against physical devices in our Munich workshop. Open source on purpose. Our CDK and our standardization work ( SiLA 2) are public. What you build gets used and criticized by people outside the company. Senior scope, small team. You'll be the person who decides how connector engineering works here. No layer between you and that decision. Your mission 1. The Builder: own the shared libraries Own Bus, the CDK, and the core stack. Features, tests, CI, releases, and deprecations across the connectors already running in production. Extract abstractions from real work. When the same pattern shows up in the third connector, it becomes a library feature. You're the one who notices, and the one who does it. Make the docs good enough to remove yourself. An outside contributor should be able to build a connector on our libraries without a call. Set the quality standard. You define what "tested" means before a connector reaches a customer, and you make it stick. 2. The Shipper: build connectors on real instruments Ship production connectors end to end. Spec sheet, physical device, protocol, proof of connectivity, tested connector, live customer. Independently. Reverse-engineer what isn't documented. Roughly half the instruments we touch have incomplete or wrong docs. Packet captures, trial and error, vendor calls. Work with the workshop. Our Connector Factory team gets instruments development-ready. You take it from there. Talk to the people who use it. Automation engineers and scientists at biotech and pharma customers. Their constraints shape what the libraries need next. Your profile Deep Python: 5+ years of writing production Python other people depend on. Async, typing, packaging, testing. You've designed APIs that other engineers built on, not just glue code. You've debugged a real protocol against real hardware: gRPC, serial, TCP, OPC UA, CAN, USB. Which one matters less than having sat with a packet capture and a device that won't respond. You ship without a spec: When the documentation is wrong, you reverse-engineer, instead of filing a vendor ticket and waiting. You build for other developers: An SDK, a library, an internal platform. Something where your job was making other engineers faster. Located in Munich: The instruments are physically here at WERK1. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: ⭐️ Your Impact: The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to deliver the energy transition. There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't last. smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working. These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging. That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker. That's what this role is for. What you'll do You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team - and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day. - Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed. - Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs. - Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability, evaluation, structured output, graceful failure. - Decide what to build. You'll write your own acceptance criteria. Nobody here will hand you a spec, and waiting for one is how to fail in this role. - Measure whether it worked. Hours saved per partner, offers that go out untouched, leads answered before a competitor picks up. If the number didn't move, it didn't work. What that looks like in practice In July one of our Meister got an early build of the partner app, ahead of the general rollout. He tested it between jobs and sent screenshots: from a calendar appointment he could no longer jump into the project to pull the customer's phone number. He had a reply in two minutes. Within the hour he'd also asked for a navigation button - tap the address, go straight to maps. Neither was news. Both were already being worked on before he hit send. We aim to be fast, and close enough to the work that we've usually seen the problem before the person living it has to tell us. ✨ What Makes You a Great Fit: You might be a great fit if you - Have owned something end to end - architecture through delivery through the unglamorous iteration afterwards. We don't count years; we look at what you carried. - Get obsessed with a problem rather than a stack. The tools change every few months. The curiosity compounds. - Would rather ship something that changes a tradesperson's week than win an argument about abstractions. - Actually like talking to customers, and have changed your mind about a feature because of something a user said. - Are comfortable being the least knowledgeable person in a room full of electricians, and ask the question anyway. - Can hold "ship it today" and "this needs to survive two years" in your head at the same time, and know which one applies. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Lead
jobs.description: Talent Acquisition Lead 📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £60,000 - £70,000 Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire. We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset. Skilled at your craft - able to land the hardest hires yourself, but also understanding what will make a whole team better at hiring - from candidate attraction to relationship building; employer brand to candidate experience. Why this role exists now Our recruiting team is strong but stacked - and as we get busier, there’s no real capacity to ensure we’re constantly innovating and improving the mechanisms that let us hire quality people at pace. We’ve recently raised investment, and have ambitious goals to achieve - now is the time to fine-tune our recruiting engine so we can scale effectively over the next few years. The role This is a role of two halves. The first half is hands-on delivery. IC L5s at Street Group are expected to confidently own the hardest searches - senior roles, niche roles, brand new roles we’ve no experience hiring for. You’ll be expected to understand how the roles you’re hiring for tie in to commercial goals, what to prioritise and why. When you run into issues, you investigate, gather qualitative and quantitative data, conduct market research, and ultimately develop solutions to solve your own problems. You share your knowledge with the team in ways that bring them on the journey - not just the “what and how” but the strong “why” behind it. The second half is taking our TA function from great to exceptional. Candidate experience, employer brand, AI, tooling, sourcing strategy, assessment - we do all of them well already, but our team holds ourselves to a high standard - and we want to do it all exceptionally well. You’ll collaborate with our Head of People on the most impactful initiatives to prioritise - the what, why, why now, and how it will be achieved and measured. We expect you to be passionate about TA; part of communities, intrigued by industry trends, new tools, best practices, and what other companies are nailing (and making sure we do it even better). Growth opportunities The business and People team will grow significantly over the next few years, and there is potential for this role to grow into a management role or specialise in a specific area, but the initial focus and goals will be hands-on, IC L5 work as mentioned above. Who we're looking for A senior recruiter with deep expertise across the full lifecycle, and the outside-in view: what the market's doing, what great TA teams do, and what it means for us. Someone who holds themselves to a high standard - e.g. measuring their results against quality of hire rather than hires made. Someone whose judgement colleagues calibrate against, trusted with delivering the most senior and confidential searches without a steer. An AI-native mindset: you treat AI as leverage and are keen to learn from our team, and share what’s been working for you. The credibility and communication skills to challenge a department head on a bad hiring decision, deliver hard market news to leadership, and come out with the relationship stronger. Someone who makes the team better on purpose, not by accident: you share what you know and help develop the people around you. Why you might not want to apply We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone. If you want to move into people management now. This is a senior IC role. You'll coach, share knowledge, and set standards, but you won't have direct reports on day one, and you'll still be carrying reqs yourself. jobs.title: Operations Generalist
jobs.description: About Freetrade Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings. We’re changing that. We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in. 2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space. This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers. About the role We're looking for an exceptional junior to join our Brokerage Operations team, either a recent graduate or someone with 1-2 years' full-time work experience. You'll support the day-to-day running of our Trade & Settlements function, covering everything from transaction reporting and fails management to best execution analysis. Over time you'll build genuine expertise across the full trade lifecycle, working alongside Trading, Settlements, Transfers, Payments, Corporate Actions and Tax. You'll also get hands-on exposure to process improvement and automation, including advanced Google Sheets, Apps Script, Regular Expressions, SQL, Zapier, and AI tools like Claude, working closely with technical specialists and engineering. Responsibilities Process and settle trades accurately and on time. Manage reconciliations, reporting and exception handling across the trade lifecycle. Support transaction reporting and fails management processes. Contribute to best-execution analysis. Identify and help implement process improvements and automations (spreadsheets, scripts, Apps Script, Zapier, AI tools). Ensure regulatory compliance and adherence to internal controls across daily operations. Work with technical specialists and engineering teams to scope and build automation solutions. Support ad hoc projects across Settlements, Transfers, Payments, Corporate Actions and Tax as needed. About you A keen interest in the brokerage environment and a desire to build deep expertise in it. Eager to stay current with market trends and regulatory change. A strong interest in process improvement and automation, always looking to optimise workflows. Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; able to work independently while collaborating openly. Takes ownership, enjoys a challenge, and is motivated to make a meaningful impact. Relevant professional qualifications or training in finance, risk management or a related field is a plus. A strong academic background in business, finance, economics or a related discipline is a plus. Benefits & Logistics Freetrade is the place to accelerate your career. Our benefits package and ways of working are designed to attract and retain the most talented people who are dedicated to making an impact at Freetrade. jobs.description: Elgin Values Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees Agility We Lead with Agility Integrity We Act with Integrity Excellence We Empower Excellence Care We Value Care Job Description Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders? We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces. This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs. To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders. What you will be do: Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover. Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions. Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations. Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors. Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements. Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner. Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
jobs.description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate ! You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving. You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate. You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat. What Can You Expect? Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack. Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting. Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation. Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest. Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day. Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate. Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly. Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible. jobs.title: Founding Senior Talent Partner
jobs.description: About Odin Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why We're Hiring We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely. You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like. This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standard we expect from candidates. And because you'll often be the first person someone meets from Odin, you'll need to give exceptional people a reason to care about a company many of them haven't heard of yet. Employer brand is a core part of the role, not something you get to once hiring goes quiet. You'll help build the content, events and community engine that puts Odin in front of the best operators in tech before they're looking for their next job - and makes hiring easier over time. Responsibilities Run hiring end to end across senior and business-critical roles, from role scoping through to start date. Own pipeline. The people we most want to hire often aren't applying, so outbound, market mapping, network building and getting others involved in referrals are a core part of the week. Run hiring kick-offs that create real clarity around what the role is, what great looks like, and how we're going to assess it. Design interview processes that test reasoning, behaviours and capability rather than rehearsed answers, using challenges, scorecards and structured assessments where appropriate. Own candidate communication end to end, with the same level of care whether someone is progressing or not. Keep employer brand top of mind and be hands-on in shaping it. Whether through content, events or community, you'll find ways to put Odin in front of the right people before they're looking for a job. Use AI as part of how you operate across sourcing, research, screening, candidate experience, operations and employer branding. Use hiring data to change decisions, prioritise roles and coach managers — not simply to report on the funnel. Continuously improve how we use Ashby, our hiring documentation and the quality of our interviews. Give clear, well-reasoned hiring recommendations with limited oversight, including when your view isn't what a hiring manager wants to hear. Who You Are An experienced recruiter with an unusually high bar for quality and strong judgement across functions. You notice patterns, inconsistencies and signals others can miss, and assess reasoning, behaviours, capability and values rather than relying on experience on paper. Brilliant at asking questions and getting underneath people's reasoning. jobs.title: Broker Development Manager
jobs.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. jobs.description: UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) . Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. The Cultural Anchor: Own It We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership : "We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev . In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible. What You’ll Work On System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks. Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling. Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions. Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments. Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations. Ideal Candidate Profile: The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for. you thrive in a dynamic environment and consistently deliver high-quality work on tight timelines</li> <li>Exceptional Excel and financial modeling skills with a knack for robust simplicity</li> <li>Strong analytical and communication skills; you’re able to both crunch numbers and discuss your analysis</li> <li>Sophisticated understanding of corporate finance and accounting</li> <li>Creative and solutions-oriented; you’re able to think on your feet when presented with a tough problem and willing to develop new approaches to challenges</li> <li>Resourceful, a problem solver who is motivated by high levels of ownership and the opportunity to have a measurable impact</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation and Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.</li> <li>Salary Range [For NYC based role]: $125,000-$165,000</li> <li>We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans, 401K matching, catered lunch on Wednesdays, and many other perks.</li> </ul> <p>There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?</p> <p>Via is an equal opportunity employer.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Football Tracking Technician (North)
jobs.description: Location: We are currently hiring across key Northern regions and North East coastal hubs. Ideal candidates will be within easy commuting distance of partner EPL and EFL stadiums across these target areas. Contract Type: Casual hourly contract – Setup Day & Match Day Hourly Rate : £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour. Rates vary depending on role Role Overview: As a Football Tracking Technician , you will work on-site at football stadiums across your region, playing a vital role in the delivery of Hawk-Eye’s tracking and officiating technologies for Premier League , EFL , and UEFA fixtures. You will be responsible for the setup , calibration , and optimisation of services including Goal Line Technology (GLT) and Electronic Performance & Tracking Systems (EPTS). This includes connecting and configuring PCs and hardware within stadium fibre-optic networks , optimising camera alignments, troubleshooting technical issues in real time, and coordinating closely with remote operations centres, on-site technical leads, and replay operators to ensure seamless match delivery. Comprehensive technical training and ongoing support will be provided, giving you full exposure to industry-leading sports technology systems and live match operations. This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in elite football environments, live broadcast technology, and high-performance sports operations at the highest level of the game. This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain practical, hands-on experience in sports technology while maintaining a flexible routine . Because live matchday operations follow the football fixture calendar - predominantly concentrated on weekends with occasional midweek commitments for training and fixtures - we are seeking candidates with strong availability to cover these key operational windows. What You’ll Be Doing: Stadium Setup: Rigging Hawk-Eye technology at the stadium. Please note: This involves physically demanding work, including running heavy cables, rigging cameras, and working at height. System Calibration: Conducting pre-match setup, hardware checks, and technical calibration of tracking systems in accordance with standard operational procedures. Live Match Monitoring: Actively monitoring hardware and software performance during live matches to instantly troubleshoot, resolve, and report technical errors. Stakeholder Management: Liaising professionally with stadium staff, match officials, and host broadcasters on-site, serving as a trusted brand ambassador for Hawk-Eye Why Is This The Right Job For You? We’re looking for individuals who are reliable, professional, and passionate about football . This position is perfect for you if you possess: Strong problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities A passion for innovation A willingness to learn The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment Flexible schedule with primary weekend availability An interest in the sport of Football Skills and Requirements Essential Criteria and Skills Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of computer hardware, networking, and fibre-optic connectivity, with a quick aptitude for learning in-house technology and software. Availability & Flexibility: : Strong schedule flexibility , with primary availability focused on weekends and occasional midweek evening matchdays/training sessions in alignment with the football calendar Professionalism: High level of professionalism and a calm, solutions-focused attitude when working in highly visible, client-facing scenarios. Mobility: A full UK driving license Passion: Strong football knowledge and a genuine interest in the sport. Desirable/Bonus Skills & Experience: Broadcast and Live events experience Video routing Knowledge Experience with Audio Over IP devices What Difficulties Might I Face? We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead - EMEA
jobs.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people. As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. jobs.title: Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Automation & Tools
jobs.description: Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen aus Berlin und seit über 15 Jahren am Markt. Dazu gehören die Konzeption und das Design neuer Systeme ebenso wie das durchgängige Monitoring und die proaktive Wartung unserer Plattformen. Durch klare Standards und technische Vorgaben schaffen wir eine stabile Basis für unseren Helpdesk und das IT‑Projekte‑Team – und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Lösungen im Alltag unserer Kund:innen technisch zuverlässig, skalierbar und stabil funktionieren. jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders)

Deine Mission bei ]init[ Du gestaltest digitale Anwendungen, die Menschen wirklich nutzen – und du denkst dabei nicht erst ab dem Screen, sondern ab dem Kundenziel und Nutzungsproblem. Als Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders) trägst du in interdisziplinären Projektteams die Verantwortung für die Gestaltung und Nutzerzentrierung komplexer Fachanwendungen, Portale und Informationsangebote – im Public und Health Sector ebenso wie in regulierten Branchen der Privatwirtschaft, etwa im Energiesektor. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Kundenanforderungen, Erkenntnissen aus der Nutzerforschung, Konzeption und visueller Umsetzung: Du denkst Design strategisch, treibst Design-Prozesse voran und verbindest konzeptionelle Stärke mit einem hohen Maß an visueller Präzision – auch an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gestaltung und technischer Umsetzung. Designsysteme sind für dich dabei kein Nebenprodukt, sondern das Rückgrat deiner Arbeit: Du baust sie auf, hältst sie über Produkte hinweg konsistent und sorgst dafür, dass sie in der Entwicklung tatsächlich ankommen. Und du nutzt KI dort, wo sie deine Arbeit besser macht: schneller zu Varianten und Umsetzung, breiter in Recherche und Analyse, konsequenter in der Qualitätssicherung – ohne die Entscheidung aus der Hand zu geben. Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von Designsystemen sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsverständnis und visuelles Stilgefühl Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden, der Gestaltung komplexer digitaler Anwendungen sowie den Anforderungen an digitale Barrierefreiheit Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams in agilen Umfeldern sowie in der Moderation von Workshops und Präsentation von Designlösungen gegenüber Kund:innen und Stakeholdern. Aussagekräftiges Portfolio, in dem du deine Arbeit von der Problemstellung bis zum finalen Interface sowie deine Erfahrung mit Designsystemen zeigst Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Our customers trust us with business-critical traffic, and we build and operate to the highest standards of certification for critical infrastructure. As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d), you will help your team design and build robust solutions for complex problems. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, who starts from the problem, reasons about the trade-offs of the environment it will run in, and reaches for the tool that fits, rather than the one on their CV. We are constantly improving our applications and we work AI-natively: AI coding agents are part of how we spec, build, and review every day. We strongly believe in “you build it, you run it, you own it” and a “collaboration culture”, where you and the team are on the frontlines and driving the change together! You start from the problem and the constraints, not from a favorite language. To you the difference between languages is largely syntax; what actually matters is the environment code runs in: performance, portability, compatibility, operational cost, and long-term maintenance You can explain your choices. You can walk us through a time you chose one language or runtime over another, and the trade-offs that drove the decision, and you can do the same for the frontend when a feature calls for it You’ve gone deep, not just broad. At least 5 years of intensive, hands-on coding and engineering experience — this is a senior role and not a fit for juniors — with genuine depth in at least one or two ecosystems. Our stack today is mostly PHP / Symfony, React and GraphQL; Edge systems use C, Rust and Python mostly. We care a lot about experience with Python, Go, C and/or Rust. These are parts that are being introduced to our dev department and where a significant part of our edge logic is based in, and someone who already reasons and builds fluently in them will make an outsized difference; this is a real signal for us, not a nice-to-have footnote Security and code quality are instincts, not afterthoughts. You write code that holds up under hostile, high-volume traffic; you treat every input as untrusted, validate rigorously, and understand how a weak boundary or a hot-path regression becomes an attack surface. jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering (Revenue Operations)
jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering . Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it. You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter. This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace. The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails. Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely. Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript. Automate across SDR, AE, and AM Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution. Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds. Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning. Take each project from prototype to production prop

jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. jobs.description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 , made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. About MoonPay Enterprise MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes. KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome. What You'll Own KYB product strategy & roadmap Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners. Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation. MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order. Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation. Onboarding funnel & conversion The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step. Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both. Fix rejection UX. jobs.title: Payroll Manager
jobs.description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're growing our payroll bureau fast and looking for a Payroll Manager to lead a team of Payroll Specialists, driving accuracy, compliance and client experience across their portfolio. This is a people-management role: you'll coach and develop your team, own escalations, and stay hands-on with payroll when it matters. You'll also be a driving force behind automation and continuous improvement, using AI to cut manual effort and building best-practice, auditable payroll flows as you go. Responsibilities Lead, coach and develop a team of Senior Payroll Specialists, Payroll Specialists and Payroll Assistants, signing off their output before it reaches clients Act as senior point of contact for your team's client payrolls, stepping in hands-on for onboarding or escalations Advise clients directly on legislative and regulatory change, and keep the team compliant with a regular gap analysis Own the team's support ticket queue and drive continuous improvement against KPIs and SLAs Lead incident resolution and root-cause analysis, escalating major issues to the Head of Payroll Bureau Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities, and coach the team to build their own Ensure Tax Year-End processing is accurate and on time, and review the team's BACS payments Requirements Proven, hands-on experience as a Payroll Manager, including in bureau/outsourced environments with enterprise clients Strong track record coaching and developing a payroll team, combining technical knowledge with people management Comfortable managing the variability of multiple payrolls across different industries within a bureau Strong background in payroll compliance and audit, with good working knowledge of payroll/HR systems and GL structures Bonus: Republic of Ireland payroll experience, CIPP qualification (or working towards one), demonstrable use of AI to automate payroll work Benefits Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho) Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. jobs.title: Operations Manager - West Midlands Sort Centre
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~110 people , more than half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft. You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation. Who will thrive in this role Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey. Who you are Scaled something from zero : a site, a market, a process or a program. Managed a physical operation : quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor. Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills : you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day. Built a mechanism that held : a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked. Own numbers rather than report them : you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards. Understand frontline work : one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ. You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment
